title: Weaver in the Chapel
description: A hooded figure sits at a large wooden loom inside a gothic stone room. The person's hands touch a paper with a flower design while a glowing fiery object flies toward the loom and an hourglass, broken crown, and spilled bucket sit on a table in front.
prompt: A hooded figure sits at a large wooden loom inside a gothic chapel with purple stone walls and arched windows. The person holds a paper with a flower design. A glowing fiery oval object flies toward the loom with sparks. In the foreground a table holds an hourglass, a broken crown with a white butterfly on it, and a spilled bucket with red liquid. Paint marks and runes stay as paint.
